# Planning components v3 — rich docs surface

After M9–M13 (planning + DocBlock + MindMap), filemark covers brainstorming + planning + decision + visual brainstorm beautifully. v3 widens the surface to **rich docs** — tutorials, marketing, dev reference, knowledge bases.

- **Date opened:** 2026-04-25
- **Status:** building
- **Companion docs:** `PLANNING_COMPONENTS.md` (v1), `PLANNING_COMPONENTS_V2.md` (v2)
- **Feeds into:** `TASKS.md` §M14 / §M15 / §M16

---

## Pillars

| Pillar | What it adds |
|---|---|
| **A. Engagement / hero** | Cards grid, Hero CTA, PullQuote, AuthorCard, Testimonials, Steps, Badge |
| **B. Knowledge connectivity** | Glossary, Footnote/Sidenote, LinkPreview, RelatedDocs, GraphView, TagCloud, Citation |
| **C. Interactive / playable** | CodePlayground, TerminalSession, Quiz, Poll, InlineForm |
| **D. Code / dev-doc** | Diff, FileTree, APIEndpoint, EnvVarsTable, PackageBadge, PRCard, IssueCard, CommitCard |
| **E. Media-rich** | VideoEmbed, AudioPlayer, ImageCompare, Lightbox, AnnotatedImage, PDFEmbed, Carousel |
| **F. Data viz extensions** | Heatmap, Treemap, Sankey, Gauge, Burndown, Sparkline (standalone) |
| **G. Doc workflow / readability** | ReadingProgress, OnThisPageMini, EditThisPage, LastUpdated, CalloutWithAction |
| **H. AI / next-gen** | AISummary placeholder, AIChat, TLDRMode |
| **I. Polish gaps in existing** | Chart annotations, Stats sparkline, Datagrid pivot, Kanban WIP, Task subtasks |

---

## Tier 1 — first slice (essential, ≤ 1 day each)

The seven that fill the biggest doc-archetype gaps: **tutorials**, **landing pages**, **dev reference**.

| Order | Component | Archetype |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Steps** (`<Steps>` + `<Step n=… title=…>`) | Tutorial / how-to |
| 2 | **Cards grid** (`<Cards>` + `<DocCard icon= title= href=>`) | Landing / index page |
| 3 | **Glossary** (`<Define term=…>`) — single-doc auto-link | Reference / spec |
| 4 | **APIEndpoint** (`<APIEndpoint method= path=>` + child blocks) | Dev reference |
| 5 | **VideoEmbed** (`<VideoEmbed src=>` — YouTube / Vimeo / Loom safe iframe) | Marketing / tutorial |
| 6 | **Diff** (`<Diff>` with `before` + `after` fenced blocks) | Migration / refactor |
| 7 | **LastUpdated** + **EditThisPage** | All long-form docs |

Plus tiny ones layered into the same milestone: **`<Badge>`** (inline pill), **`<Steps n=… title=…>`** stepper variant.

## Tier 2 — power features

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **Heatmap** | GitHub-style activity grid from CSV |
| **AnnotatedImage** | Image + numbered hotspots that pop a markdown caption |
| **PullQuote** + **Testimonials** | Marketing surface |
| **Footnote / Sidenote** | Tufte margin notes |
| **Sparkline** standalone | Inline trend visual |
| **Chart annotations** + **Stats sparkline** | Polish gaps in existing components |
| **Glossary cross-doc** | Auto-link any term defined anywhere in the library |

## Tier 3 — niche / when a use case pulls

| Component | Pitch |
|---|---|
| **PRCard / IssueCard / CommitCard** | GitHub artifacts as styled cards |
| **FileTree** | Interactive file tree |
| **EnvVarsTable** | Env vars with type / default / secret-mask |
| **Lightbox** | Click image → full-screen overlay |
| **Carousel** | Horizontal scroll-snap card row |
| **Gauge** | Single-value dial |
| **Treemap** | Nested rectangles sized by value |
| **Quiz** | Multi-choice question with reveal |
| **Poll** | Single-question vote, persisted |
| **AISummary** | Placeholder for a host-provided summariser |
| **CalloutWithAction** | Callout + primary button |
| **AuthorCard** | Inline author bio |

## Skip / defer (heavy or external infra)

- CodePlayground (sandpack, 100+ KB)
- GraphView (force layout lib)
- Sankey (d3-sankey)
- AudioPlayer with waveform
- PDFEmbed (PDF.js)
- TerminalSession (animated typing)
- Burndown (needs historical task parsing)
- AIChat (host AI integration)

Revisit when a concrete doc demands them.

---

## How to use this doc

- New ideas land under the appropriate pillar.
- When a tier item is picked, copy it into `TASKS.md` under M14 / M15 / M16 with full filemark sigils.
- When shipped, flip `[ ]` → `[x]` here AND in `TASKS.md`.
- Prune anything in Tier 3 that hasn't moved in three months.
